nuget tool-shell race (production blocker): 6 parallel per-RID pack jobs emitted the same shell nupkg; --skip-duplicate kept whichever pushed first and its DotnetToolSettings.xml referenced ONLY linux-musl-x64 — 'dotnet tool install' rejected every other platform (verified: published 1.0.1 AND 1.0.2 shells both broken). Fix (PR #20, merged 3bfd198): scripts/patch-tool-shell.py rewrites a shell's RuntimeIdentifierPackages to all six RIDs, run in every matrix job so all candidate shells are identical and correct; self-gating (fails unless every RID present exactly once, ids match prefix, entries/[Content_Types].xml preserved, rid count == matrix). Reviewer APPROVE (2 minor + 3 nit hardening applied: prefix validation, EntryPoint/Runner preservation, ordered payloads-first push, py3.9-compatible annotations). 1.0.3 was dispatched from old main pre-merge but the fixed workflow's push won — live 1.0.3 turned out CORRECT (inspected). 1.0.4 deployed via PR #21 (merged c638ccd) and pushed by the fixed workflow: payloads first then shell, 5 duplicate shells deduped; validation pending. E2E proven on macOS: pack -> patch -> local-only feed -> dotnet tool install -> runs 1.0.3/1.0.4.

bug-hunt: 'ai-raccoon watch enable * true' broke cryptically (wall of 'Unrecognized command or argument <file>' + Boolean parse error). Root cause traced + reproduced: unquoted '*' is shell-expanded into every cwd entry before the CLI sees it; the documented {project-id|*} syntax made this the natural way to say 'all projects'. Fix (PR #19, merged 3a845d8): CliRendering detects the expansion signature (unrecognized tokens that are cwd entries, all-but-one majority, + typed-argument Boolean/Int32 fallback) and appends a hint teaching the quoted form with the command reconstructed ('ai-raccoon watch enable '*' true'); exit 1 unchanged; stderr-only discipline kept. Refactor per architect+QA plans: CliArgs.cs -> facade + Setup/Cli/CliCommandTree.cs + Setup/Cli/CliRendering.cs (75 in-scope CLI tests, full suite 1062/0/43, byte-identical rendering verified member-by-member by reviewer). Docs (README/reference/prompt) teach quoting. Reviewer: no blockers/majors; 1 minor follow-up (ConfigCommands.cs:496 warning still teaches unquoted 'watch scope add * <path>') folded into the watch-list-format task. Durable lesson: any CLI wildcard in user-facing syntax needs shell-quoting guidance at every surface that shows it.

Benchmarked System.Buffers.SearchValues<string> vs HashSet on the FTS query path (BenchmarkDotNet, real 35-query corpus). Measured: SearchValues under production's OrdinalIgnoreCase REGRESSES (1.12x — its Contains is an internal HashSet; Teddy/Aho-Corasick only accelerate IndexOfAny spans); the gain is Ordinal (tokens are pre-lowercased before checks, sets are lowercase ASCII): HashSet+Ordinal 0.71x, SearchValues+Ordinal 0.60x. Replaced Reserved/Stopwords in FtsQueryNormalizer + SourcePathQuery with SearchValues.Create(Ordinal); left IndexableExtensions as HashSet OIC (input not normalized; SearchValues slower there). 2 new casing-contract tests pin the pre-lowercasing precondition. Full suite green (471 passed/43 skipped). Findings: docs/work/2026-08-04-searchvalues-vs-hashset.md; benchmark kept in benchmarks/AiRaccoon.Benchmarks. Merged to main.
